summary: Zamboanga Sibugay 2nd District representative with 28 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant items are travel-tax abolition and co-authored VAT exemption on electricity and a higher income tax exemption, all taxation. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.

economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
